scope: Complete-original-body prerequisite review of the remaining CLI original. This is not terminal execution or a permanent exclusion.
linked_reference_caveat: Only the complete original was read. Runtime interfaces, preflight, contract schema, controller format, recording manifests, evidence assembler and actual public executable need separate review. No original command or subject process was executed.

sources.workflow: Run the exact approved terminal behavior case through the owned Go runtime and thin terminal adapter, retaining immediate setup, exercise, validation and cleanup chronology. Observe actual terminal revision before each permitted action, close each run before the next, and preserve partial evidence and actual exit state on every outcome.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A ready genuine preflight receipt, complete approved executable and workspace contract, exact executable checksum, reviewed Go owner and terminal adapter, actual subject program and recording/evidence interfaces are required. Controllers are constrained declarative inputs rather than arbitrary new authority. Real credentials must not be typed or persisted. The original explicitly states that configuration isolation does not make the host an operating-system sandbox.
sources.offline_assessment: An isolated terminal exercise of a reviewed benign public program may be possible offline with the exact native tools and contract. The default standard-library container does not provide that Go and Node terminal stack, and a shared unsandboxed host is not an acceptable substitute for executing untrusted subject programs. Saved stills, manufactured timestamps or a textual transcript do not demonstrate actual interaction or chronology.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Bind the approved contract and immediately verified executable to actual terminal observations, revisions, permitted actions, capture directories and final native process state. Reconcile runtime start and finish timestamps, real setup-exercise-validation ordering and owned-resource shutdown. Preserve stale-observation rejection and interruption separately from goal success. Legacy recordings without chronology metadata remain explicitly unverified rather than repaired by clip rearrangement.

source_reader: Direct complete-original-body review; exact cohort selection, original hashes, line totals, disjoint IDs and citation bounds independently reconciled by parent.
status_scope: Only original-body prerequisites; linked references, concrete tasks and runtime evidence remain distinct.
